back.target: feel free to, go ahead and (modal particle encouraging someone; literally calm, quiet)
back.example: You can go ahead and sit down.

note: Gern(e) can also mean feel free here (Du kannst dich gerne hinsetzen), but it is an adverb rather than a modal particle, so the hint's word particle points to ruhig; the editor may want the hint to say not gern to be safe.
